t: Introduction and overview — Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Russian carrier Admiral Kuznetsov — 58,600 tons with a ski-jump — operates Su-33 and MiG-29K fighters. Plagued by maintenance woes, fires, and a sinking drydock, she has spent years in refit. Her sister ship was completed by China as the Liaoning. Baseline facts: Russian ski-jump carrier; 58,600 tons; Su-33/MiG-29K; long troubled refit..

title: Comparison with contemporaries — Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier
description: Comparison with contemporaries of the Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The Russian carrier Admiral Kuznetsov — 58,600 tons with a ski-jump — operates Su-33 and MiG-29K fighters. Plagued by maintenance woes, fires, and a sinking drydock, she has spent years in refit. Her sister ship was completed by China as the Liaoning. Baseline facts: Russian ski-jump carrier; 58,600 tons; Su-33/MiG-29K; long troubled refit..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
key_points: Admiral Kuznetsov Aircraft Carrier: How the class compared with rival navies' ships.
